sprites.requested_resolution: Maximum native portrait output supported by the generator; no upscaling
sprites.prompt: Generate ONE original, finished, painterly historical Chinese xianxia visual novel character sprite as a native RGBA PNG with a fully transparent background. Request the maximum native portrait resolution the generator supports; do not upscale. A single full-body uncut adult woman, the head, both hands, hem and both boots entirely within the canvas, with generous transparent margin all around and no scenery, floor, cast shadow, lettering or frame. Character: Qiu Zhen, 32, a female cultivation practitioner whose registered level is Qi Gathering 5: Four pairs. Tall and lean, a tan angular face, an alert reserved expression with a hint of proud competitive resolve, black hair in one practical long braid. She wears a dark cinnabar cross-collar work robe with charcoal sleeves, a fitted charcoal sash, finely textured simple cloth and practical flat black boots. One hand holds a neatly coiled rolled survey cord, the other lightly holds a small hand-size bronze measuring gauge. She is a working surveyor and a worthy rival with a livelihood of her own, not an aristocratic princess. Grounded natural human anatomy, three-quarter view looking slightly toward the viewer's left, stable relaxed stance. Rich but muted reds, charcoal and warm skin. Fine expressive face and hands, subtle brushwork and detailed folds, convincing wear around cuffs and boots, crisp clean silhouette, consistent soft neutral studio light suitable for compositing over multiple environments. The visual style is refined painterly game concept art rooted in historical Chinese clothing, realistic adult proportions, gently stylized with clear readable silhouettes. No sword, no weapon, no armor, no glowing aura, no luminous meridians, no magic effects, no levitation. No separate props or multiple views, only one whole-body character. Preserve native pixels and transparency.
